name: coinmarketcap-crypto-ts
display_name: CoinMarketCap Top Crypto & Market Cap Explorer (TypeScript)
description: Fetches top cryptocurrency listings from CoinMarketCap. If an API key is supplied in the environment, it will be used; otherwise, the public endpoint will be used (the API is the same). Output currency is configurable, and results can be sorted by market cap (default), price, price change (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 60d, 90d), and 24-hour trading volume.

action.description: The top-level call to dispatch. `rankAssets` is the primary action that returns crypto asset listings. `listCurrencies` is a helper action that lists the currencies supported by the `currency` option to `rankAssets`.

options.description: An options object supporting the `rankAssets` action.

limit.description: The number of results to fetch from CoinMarketCap.

currency.description: The currency used in the results. Call the `listCurrencies` action for a list of currency symbols supported by CoinMarketCap.

rankBy.description: The order in which to rank assets returned by `rankAssets`.
